title: Privacy Policy
description: How information is handled when you use the We Paint Siding website.

sections.title: About this notice
paragraphs: This notice describes the current We Paint Siding website. It explains the website's forms, technical services and third-party content. Information exchanged through a separate business relationship or another service may be handled under additional notices provided through that channel.

sections.title: Quote request drafts
paragraphs: The quote tools ask for details such as your name, contact information, location and painting project. The current tools process those entries in your browser to create a downloadable text file. They do not send the entries to We Paint Siding or create a submitted enquiry.

The downloaded file remains on your device until you remove it. The visible form values may remain in the page or be remembered by your browser's own autofill features. Avoid including payment details, identification documents or other sensitive information in a project description.

sections.title: Newsletter and accounts
paragraphs: Newsletter registration is not active. Entering an email address and pressing Subscribe displays a status message; it does not add you to a mailing list. The website does not currently provide customer accounts or online payment processing.

sections.title: Technical information and hosting
paragraphs: The website is hosted on Vercel. When a browser requests a page or file, technical information such as an IP address, request details and browser information can be processed by the hosting service to deliver and protect the website. The website application does not include an advertising tracker or analytics integration.
Provider processing and retention can vary with the service and its configuration. This notice does not promise a fixed retention period or a particular processing location for provider records.

sections.title: Maps and external services
paragraphs: Some pages embed Google Maps. Loading an embedded map connects your browser to Google, which may process technical information and use cookies or similar technologies under its own policies. Your browser settings, existing Google session and use of the map can affect that processing.
External websites operate under their own privacy notices. Our fonts and website image files are served with the site rather than loaded from an external font library.

sections.title: Your choices
paragraphs: You can choose not to enter details in the quote tool, remove downloaded drafts, clear browser autofill information and manage cookies through your browser. You can also avoid pages with embedded maps or use browser controls that restrict third-party content.
If you provide information separately through an established business contact channel, ask about its purpose, handling and any available access or correction options through that channel.

sections.title: Privacy enquiries
paragraphs: For a privacy enquiry, use an established contact channel supplied to you by We Paint Siding. The current website quote tool downloads a draft and does not deliver privacy requests. Do not rely on a downloaded draft as confirmation that a request has been received.

sections.title: Changes to this notice
paragraphs: This page will need to be updated if online submissions, subscriptions, accounts, analytics or other services are enabled. The date above identifies this version of the website notice.

title: Cookies Policy
description: Cookies, browser storage and third-party services on this website.

sections.title: What cookies are
paragraphs: Cookies are small pieces of information stored by a browser when a website or service asks it to do so. Similar technologies can store information in the browser or help a service recognize a request.

sections.title: Current website features
paragraphs: The website application does not currently set advertising cookies, integrate an analytics service or use local storage to remember marketing preferences. Menus, article filters and comparison sliders hold their current state in the open page.
Quote tools generate local downloads. Newsletter registration is inactive. These features do not create a mailing-list or advertising profile through the website application.

sections.title: Hosting and embedded maps
paragraphs: The site is hosted by Vercel, which may process technical requests for delivery and security. Embedded Google Maps can contact Google when the map loads and may use cookies or similar technologies. Existing provider cookies may also be sent according to your browser settings.
Provider behavior can change and can depend on your account, browser and region. This page does not claim that no third-party cookies can be present.

sections.title: Managing browser settings
paragraphs: Most browsers let you review or remove stored site data and restrict third-party cookies. Use the privacy or site settings in your browser for the options available on your device. Restricting provider content may affect embedded maps.
Changing browser settings does not remove a quote draft already downloaded to your device. You can delete that file separately.

sections.title: Future changes and questions
paragraphs: If optional tracking or new storage-based features are added, this notice and the available choices will need to be updated. For more about the current site's handling of information, read the Privacy Policy.

title: Disclaimer
description: Important context for website guides, imagery and project information.

sections.title: General website information
paragraphs: The website provides general information about painting services and project planning. Guides cannot account for every material, previous coating, property condition or coating system. Obtain advice and a written scope for your own project before deciding how work should proceed.

sections.title: Illustrative images and comparisons
paragraphs: Website imagery includes generated illustrative photographs. Before and after sliders demonstrate painting concepts and are not records of completed client projects unless a particular image is expressly identified as such.

Example project descriptions illustrate possible goals and scopes. They do not establish that a pictured property belongs to a customer, document an actual result, or promise the same outcome for another property.

sections.title: Colours and finishes
paragraphs: Colours shown on a screen may differ from physical samples and completed surfaces because of display settings, lighting and materials. Confirm colour and finish choices with suitable samples and the agreed project details.

sections.title: Quotes, schedules and warranties
paragraphs: General website statements are not an individual quotation, booking or warranty. Scope, preparation, products, price, scheduling and any warranty terms should be confirmed in your own written agreement. A downloaded request draft has not been submitted or accepted.

sections.title: Third-party resources
paragraphs: Maps and external links are provided for convenience. Third-party content can change and is governed by the provider's own terms and notices. Inclusion of a link does not guarantee the provider's content or services.

sections.title: Questions about a project
paragraphs: Use the service pages and painting guides as a starting point for your questions. Confirm uncertain details with the team handling your project before work begins.

title: Terms of Use
description: Terms for browsing and using the We Paint Siding website.

sections.title: Website purpose
paragraphs: This website presents information about We Paint Siding services and provides general painting guides. These website terms do not replace an individual project agreement or determine the scope of painting services.

sections.title: Responsible use
paragraphs: Use the website for lawful purposes. Do not attempt to disrupt its operation, bypass security controls, access information without permission or submit misleading information through its features.

sections.title: Content and imagery
paragraphs: Website text, layout, branding and imagery are provided for viewing this site and considering its services. Do not represent illustrative imagery or example descriptions as your own documented project work. Third-party materials remain subject to their respective rights and licenses.

sections.title: Enquiries and service agreements
paragraphs: The quote tool currently creates a request draft on your device. It does not send an enquiry, make a booking or form a service agreement. Newsletter registration is not active.

Any painting project requires separately agreed details, including the scope, preparation, products, access, schedule, price and applicable terms. General website information is not a substitute for those details.

sections.title: Availability and external resources
paragraphs: Pages and features may change or be unavailable during maintenance. External websites and embedded services operate under their own terms. Review the relevant provider's notices when you use those services.

sections.title: Information and questions
paragraphs: Read the Privacy Policy, Cookies Policy and Disclaimer for information about current website features. Nothing on these pages is intended to remove rights that cannot lawfully be excluded.

title: Accessibility
description: Using the site and understanding its accessibility features.

sections.title: Our approach
paragraphs: We aim to make the site clear and usable across devices. This page describes available features; it is not a claim of certification or complete conformance with a particular accessibility standard.

sections.title: Navigation and keyboard access
paragraphs: A Skip to content link appears at the start of each page. You can use Tab and Shift+Tab to move between interactive controls. Service and location panels open through their main labels, and Escape closes an open panel.
Links inside each panel provide access to its main page and individual services or communities. On touch devices, tap the main label to expand or collapse its panel.

sections.title: Reading and interactive content
paragraphs: Content uses headings and responsive layouts. Images include descriptive alternative text. Article contents links jump to the relevant section, and blog search and topic filters show an updated result count.
Before and after controls are range inputs. Focus a comparison and use the arrow keys to adjust it; Home and End move to the endpoints. Frequently asked questions use expandable disclosure controls.

sections.title: Motion, zoom and third-party content
paragraphs: The site respects a browser preference for reduced motion. You can use browser zoom and device text settings when reading the content. Third-party maps have their own controls and may have different accessibility behavior.

sections.title: Reporting a barrier
paragraphs: If you encounter a barrier, note the page, the action you were trying to complete and the browser or assistive technology involved. Share those details through an established We Paint Siding contact channel. The website quote tool only downloads a draft and does not transmit an accessibility report.
